scope: Convex RBF SVM+ dual Eq. 2 with independently computed feasible primal and primal-dual gap. GAGS-inspired two-island log-grid GA, crossover/mutation and fresh diversity seeds; actual two-worker candidate evaluations. Random search has the same 16 unique-candidate budget. Narrow ranges, small synthetic LUPI data and independent privileged-space SVC tiebreak are explicit adaptations. No MNIST/CWRU or paper-speedup reproduction; test privileged features are never used for inference or selection.

environment.scope: Shared cloud CPU; not student laptop; one BLAS thread.
